fields.productName: Kirkland Signature Real Heavy Whipped Cream
fields.whatHappened: Alamance Foods is voluntarily recalling Kirkland Signature Real Heavy Whipped Cream sold at Costco. Members reported a chemical smell and taste. No serious adverse effects requiring medical care have been reported. The affected cans have timestamps from 00:35 to 02:45.
fields.whyRecalled: One batch may contain a small amount of a cleaning chemical.
instructions: If you still have the product, stop using it.
Return it to your local Costco for a full refund.
